key_findings: Identified 5 critical gaps preventing MASTER_PROMPT bootstrap from working in new projects
Missing automatic trigger when ARCHITECTURE.md is absent
Asymmetric pipeline design: PROJECT_MAP.md has fallback creation logic but ARCHITECTURE.md does not
MASTER_PROMPT content is generated correctly but never persisted to disk
Pipeline Phase 1 checks for ARCHITECTURE.md but provides no mechanism to create it
file_insights.evidence_provided: Line-by-line citations from SKILL.md, pipeline.md, MASTER_PROMPT.md with specific line numbers and quoted text
file_insights.scope: New project bootstrap path validation for web stack (Next.js, React, Vue)

patterns_discovered.description: SKILL.md declares automatic behavior ('Apply only when ARCHITECTURE.md is missing') but pipeline implementation has no trigger for this condition
patterns_discovered.evidence: SKILL.md line 155 vs pipeline.md lines 176-189 have no MASTER_PROMPT invocation logic

patterns_discovered.description: Related files are handled inconsistently: PROJECT_MAP.md has explicit fallback creation logic ('create it in Phase 7') while ARCHITECTURE.md lacks any creation mechanism
patterns_discovered.evidence: pipeline.md line 189 (PROJECT_MAP fallback) vs line 177 (ARCHITECTURE.md no fallback)

patterns_discovered.description: MASTER_PROMPT documentation says 'Pin decisions in ARCHITECTURE.md' but never explicitly states 'CREATE the file' or 'WRITE to disk'
patterns_discovered.evidence: web/MASTER_PROMPT.md line 3 uses passive voice; reproductions show content generated but not written to filesystem

patterns_discovered.description: New-project bootstrap workflow has never been tested end-to-end in the actual system despite being documented
patterns_discovered.evidence: documentation/WORKFLOW.md line 80 acknowledges: 'New-project path barely tested'

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Content Generation vs File Persistence Decoupling
gotchas_discovered.description: Test project reproductions (nextjs-new, ios-new, android-new) proved MASTER_PROMPT generates high-quality architecture content but never creates ARCHITECTURE.md on disk. Content only existed in manual REPRODUCTION.md files.
gotchas_discovered.implication: System architecture appears correct but automated file creation/invocation is missing entirely

gotchas_discovered.description: Phase 1 explicitly checks for ARCHITECTURE.md but has no fallback behavior when absent, violating the 'Memory Establishment' principle (pipeline.md Guiding Principles line 9)
gotchas_discovered.implication: Pipeline would continue without architecture documentation on new projects, causing downstream phases to fail or produce suboptimal results

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: No Grep Results for MASTER_PROMPT in Pipeline
gotchas_discovered.description: Searching 995 lines of pipeline.md yielded zero MASTER_PROMPT references despite SKILL.md declaring it as automatic
gotchas_discovered.implication: Invocation mechanism was never implemented in the automation layer

gotchas_discovered.description: MASTER_PROMPT header is unclear whether it should: (a) generate text for manual file creation, (b) write ARCHITECTURE.md automatically, or (c) provide interactive template
gotchas_discovered.implication: Claude instances invoking MASTER_PROMPT have no clear signal on whether to write files or return descriptions

methodology: Document inspection: Examined SKILL.md, pipeline.md, MASTER_PROMPT.md for contradictions
Pattern comparison: Contrasted working PROJECT_MAP.md fallback logic with non-working ARCHITECTURE.md approach
Reproduction testing: Created three test projects (nextjs-new, ios-new, android-new) and manually invoked MASTER_PROMPT
Evidence collection: Gathered line-by-line citations and diff outputs to support each finding
approach_outcome.key_achievement: Identified root cause is not WHAT MASTER_PROMPT generates (quality is excellent) but WHEN and HOW it gets invoked and persisted
approach_outcome.confidence_level: HIGH — reproductions validated content generation works; only invocation automation and file persistence are missing

recommendations.title: Add Bootstrap Trigger to Pipeline Phase 2
recommendations.action: Add new step after stack detection: If ARCHITECTURE.md missing, apply appropriate MASTER_PROMPT variant and write result to disk
recommendations.rationale: Phase 2 already detects stack; bootstrap trigger should follow naturally

recommendations.title: Make File Creation Explicit in MASTER_PROMPT
recommendations.action: Replace ambiguous 'Pin decisions in ARCHITECTURE.md' with explicit 'Create ARCHITECTURE.md at repo root containing:' plus structured template
recommendations.rationale: Removes ambiguity about whether Claude should write files or return descriptions

recommendations.title: Add ARCHITECTURE.md Fallback to Phase 1
recommendations.action: Change 'Check for ARCHITECTURE.md' to 'Check for ARCHITECTURE.md; if absent, flag for creation in Phase 2'
recommendations.rationale: Makes expectations explicit and sets up Phase 2 bootstrap trigger

recommendations.title: Update SKILL.md to Clarify Automatic Bootstrap
recommendations.action: Distinguish between automatic bootstrap (pipeline Phase 2) vs manual re-architecture (user-initiated)
recommendations.rationale: Removes confusion about whether users must manually 'apply' MASTER_PROMPT

recommendations.title: Test Bootstrap Across All Supported Stacks
recommendations.scope: Next.js 14, React (Vite), Vue 3, iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), KMP
success_criteria: Pipeline continues to Phase 3+ without manual intervention
Existing projects (with ARCHITECTURE.md) skip bootstrap cleanly

recommendations.action: Repeat root cause analysis for mobile MASTER_PROMPT (subtask-2-2)
recommendations.reason: Same bootstrap patterns likely apply to iOS/Android/KMP stacks
